verdict.rationale: Groq's docs mention speed-related features (service tiers, flex processing) but never publish concrete tokens-per-second/latency benchmark tables or a load-testing guide; independent community reports do supply hands-on numbers (491 T/s and 450+ T/s on Mixtral, ~200 T/s on Llama2-70B) that corroborate the general 'fast inference' claim, though other community posts report poor real-world throughput and reliability, adding caveats. missing for 10: an official Groq-published benchmark/latency page, a load-testing guide, and resolution of conflicting community throughput/reliability reports.
